meta.task: Work Order Schedule Timeline (Naologic front-end take-home)
meta.how: Each item is checkable. An agent may set status to pass only with an evidence command (test name, screenshot path, or measurement output). Token references point into docs/design/tokens.json.

verifyKinds.unit: covered by an automated unit test
verifyKinds.e2e: covered by a browser test (Playwright or equivalent)
verifyKinds.visual: measured against docs/design/tokens.json, or screenshot compared to the design
verifyKinds.manual: verified by a human looking at the running app
